description: On the bed in front of you there are several paperback books and an open, upright slipcase sitting near the center. The left hand reaches to the right to pick up a red book, lifts it, rotates it upright, and slides it into the open slipcase, then grasps a blue book and inserts it beside the red one, and finally lifts a green book and moves it toward the slipcase to place it next to the others; the right hand is not touching anything.
